prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1291; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in the parking lot of a retail center. Insured vehicle was struck while reversing from a space by a second vehicle. Both drivers reported no visible damage to the roadway. Photos requested from both parties.

Entry 2: Spoke with the claimant by phone. Claimant reports neck stiffness and headache beginning the following morning and has since seen a primary care provider. Claimant states they are not represented by an attorney and prefers to handle the claim directly. Explained the claims process and requested medical authorization forms.

Entry 3: Received photos of both vehicles. Damage to the rear bumper of the claimant's vehicle is consistent with the reported impact. Estimate requested from the preferred repair shop. Witness statement from a store employee obtained, confirming the second vehicle backed into the claimant's car.

Entry 4: Claimant returned signed medical authorization and submitted treatment notes diagnosing whiplash-associated disorder. Treatment plan includes physical therapy sessions twice weekly for six weeks. Reviewed policy limits for bodily injury coverage with the claimant as part of standard communication. No attorney involvement noted to date.

Entry 5: Liability position under review based on witness statement and photos. Preliminary assessment favors the other driver as at-fault. Medical records requested for the prior three years to confirm no pre-existing neck complaints. Follow-up call scheduled with claimant to discuss next steps and status of the repair estimate.
